title: Cross-Correlations of Metric and Monopole Perturbations from Holographic Cosmology
summary: In this paper, we present the 1-loop calculation of the three-point function $\langle TJJ \rangle$ of the stress-energy tensor and two insertions of $SO(3)$ global currents, using a 3d toy model for holographic cosmology.
